name: Rho Markets native-ETH feed overwritten by rWBTC listing
summary: PriceOracleV2 keys each Chainlink feed by the configured underlying of an rToken. Rho listed rWBTC without setting its RTokenConfig, so its underlying remained the zero address used by the native-ETH market. The admin's subsequent rWBTC feed transaction therefore replaced the ETH/USD feed with WBTC/USD and made 1 ETH read as $63,653.144. Seven borrow transactions then used ETH collateral at that price to remove wstETH from the rwstETH market.

loss.notes: The seven campaign receipts show rwstETH 0xe4fc4c444effb5eca80274c021f652980794eae6 transferring exactly 1,233.956023308315527280 wstETH to the attack helper. In the same transactions the helper sold that wstETH through pool 0x05dff4a55473562dd26bdbe4f74410a7307175bf for 1,443.560249567875793338 WETH. Valuing the realised WETH at the legitimate ETH/USD Chainlink answer of $3,384.18 immediately before the bad feed write gives $4,885,267.725382613902298592. Attacker-supplied flash loans and ETH collateral are excluded. The later return of funds does not reduce gross pre-recovery loss. The legacy $7.6m report is not retained because it does not reconcile with the victim's complete wstETH outflow during the mispricing window.

ageReset.description: The Rho admin called setChainlinkPriceFeed for an rWBTC market whose missing RTokenConfig made getUnderlying(rWBTC) return address(0), overwriting the zero-address feed used by native ETH. getUnderlyingPrice(rETH) changed from 3,384.18e18 to 63,653.144e18 across this block and no later feed-setting event preceded the anchor.

sources.note: Anchor and mechanism: transaction 0x9d2388a0c449c6265b968d86f0f54e75a5b82e2b04176e35eefdff5f135547ec at block 7580111:2 called setChainlinkPriceFeed on PriceOracleV2 for rWBTC 0x1d73ead2bbea318344fccd7142f70488bab08f44. No RTokenConfig had been set for rWBTC, so the contract keyed the WBTC/USD feed by address(0), the same key used by rETH 0x639355f34ca9935e0004e30bd77b9ce2ada0e692. Historical calls reproduce getUnderlyingPrice(rETH) changing from 3,384.18e18 at block 7580110 to 63,653.144e18 at block 7580111. No later ChainlinkPriceFeed-set event exists through block 7580142. The first attacker transaction follows 32 blocks and 77 seconds later and its trace repeatedly reaches the oracle proxy, which delegatecalls 0xb14df613f4b30ffffe9811a11f2931de011391d9. Target history: the proxy was created top-level by 0xaa6745049b1a7f9f63524aef23db924e2e45d221 in transaction 0x06aa1fb0989cb874d876c0b276d972807fcf72f0ba6430cbe32eded26bd4e928 at block 6812594:15. Its EIP-1967 implementation slot holds 0xb14df613f4b30ffffe9811a11f2931de011391d9 at creation and at the anchor, and that implementation's runtime hashes to 0x382670aef0b31165479a3040b4b19e7a6e7c4954586c5206fdc15fa3d25b50ea in the anchor prestate. Loss: the seven successful campaign receipts contain rwstETH-market outflows totaling 1,233.956023308315527280 wstETH to helper 0xe2704980704b26f9ee909daa44750498bc8c3702. Matching WETH Transfer logs from the wstETH/WETH pool total 1,443.560249567875793338 WETH of same-transaction proceeds. The legitimate ETH/USD feed read $3,384.18 immediately before the reset, producing the declared onchain-derived USD value.
